items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Last name was Washington, I'm trying to think of her first name.

ctx.x: Well, you know we talked earlier about the band having regular vocalists. And you talked about Herb and Billy Eckstine. And there was -- were there girl singers, too?
Yes. Outside of Valaida Snow we had Ida James, and what was her name? Last name was Washington, I'm trying to think of her first name. She's real tall girl. We picked her up in Washington.
But there was always a male and a female singer?
